answer: The pearl graph is validated at intake and the reef frontier is published, which means the ancestry of every answer is public, and dawn anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 3 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Running 243 accounts means paying 275 times the fee up front and waiting 8 weeks for the first one to clear, which no honest participant ever has to do. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
